Method of Attack: Phishing emails with malicious XLSX document attachments to load trojan
Use of Microsoft Compiled HTML Help file (CHM) or malicious Excel document in RAR attachments
CHM payload executes commands to create scheduled tasks and download next stage
Exploitation of older Equation Editor vulnerability via malicious Excel document
Second-stage payloads include MSI, PowerShell, or EXE files
Empty second-stage payloads that send device info to command and control server to determine valuable targets
Potential delivery of keyloggers, RATs, and info-stealers
Impacted Systems: Devices in Chinese nuclear energy industry
Users in New Zealand, India, Pakistan, and the United Kingdom
Attack Vector: Phishing emails pretending to be from Embassy of Kyrgyzstan in Beijing
Emails with RAR attachments containing malicious CHM or Excel files
